_doc: Equivalence-prover allowlist. Every entry acknowledges an INTENDED divergence between the current tree and validation/baselines/v68. Entries require file (repo-relative), reason, and wave (e.g. v6.9). The prover fails on any un-allowlisted diff and on any stale entry whose file no longer diverges.

entries.reason: v6.8.1 microcopy fixes: (1) the micro ships-from row now YIELDS when the dedicated az_ships_from line is effective (azShipsAllowed() gate) so the buy box never says Ships-from twice; (2) label resolution unchanged otherwise. Companion CSS guard .cx-az-micro__row[hidden]{display:none!important} fixes the display:flex-defeats-[hidden] bare-truck-icon bug (CSS is outside baseline scope).

v6.10 merchant-selectable ships-from display format: azShipsFormat() decodes the lean 's'/'p' code from the gated ships member (draft override preview.sf only inside a VERIFIED preview session, fail-closed to subtle); azBuildStock gains a shipsName param and a prominent branch (.cx-az-stock__ships--prominent: truck icon + @@COUNTRY@@ sentinel split into prefix/country/suffix, textContent-only, sentinel-less fallback to the plain composed line); azMountStock hoists the warehouse name. Subtle path markup byte-identical to v6.8. Pinned by sims/az-split.cjs F1-F5 + mutants m6/m7.

v6.11 survey methodology full-text editability: surveyBuildPanel's merchant branch substitutes the built-in text's live-number tokens ({{ total }}/{{ yes }}/{{ percent }}, flexible inner whitespace) with the cfg.survey numbers before the textContent write, so a merchant-edited copy of the built-in explanation keeps tracking the survey numbers. Fail-safe 0 on non-finite numbers; sink stays textContent-only. Pinned by sims/survey-methodology.cjs M1-M7 + mutants m1-m4 and harness section-5 v6.11 pins.

v7 per-product proof wave: survey gates + island rewritten per-product (cellexia.product_survey metaobject read, content-presence gate, per-product outcome rows + methodology/verifier fallbacks, legacy sampleSize/yesCount/format reads and the draft surveyFormat preview member removed); study island gains sub/pn/pw/pl/pi members (m1/m2 composition retired) + str.sub/str.fn; bottle title now interpolates the pluralized days label and body/point_1..3 gain theme-block overrides (+4 schema settings). Pinned by harness section-5 v7 block + sims/survey-methodology.cjs.

v7 per-product proof wave: five-format survey machinery (SURVEY_FORMATS, surveyBuildFormat, buildSurveyDots, cfg.preview.surveyFormat) replaced by one zero-arg outcomes-forward surveyBuildSection (derived row percents, decorative bar fills, @@YES@@/@@TOTAL@@ sentinel labels, fail-closed row/total/rec validation); surveyBuildPanel keeps v6.11 token substitution with per-product numbers (total=sample size, yes=rec); study builder gains the always-on subject line + protocol fact chips and drops m1/m2 paragraphs. Pinned by sims/survey-methodology.cjs (59 checks, 7 mutants) + harness v7 block.

v6.10 ships-from format plumbing: the gated ships member gains the lean live format code ("f": cfg.amazon.shipsFromFormat | slice: 0, the v6.5 place-code convention) and the armed preview member gains the lean draft code ("sf": cx_prev.draftConfig.shipsFromFormat | slice: 0, tokenless closed enum). No gate or emission-structure changes.

v8 proof library + compact modes: the #cx-ba-config island emission is DELETED (the PDP before/after widget retires — the standalone results-gallery block replaces it; the show_ba/cx_bas reads are kept because they still feed the outer emission gate and cx_draft_any), and the survey/study/bottle islands gain lean LIVE compact members ('"cm": 1' under cfg.dermSurvey.compact / cfg.clinicalStudy.compact / cfg.emptyBottleGuarantee.compact == true strict gates) plus the compact-gated surveyStrings.more_outcomes key. Pinned by harness section-5 v8 block + sims/survey-methodology.cjs C-series.

v8 compact modes + BA retirement: surveyBuildSection grows the compact branch (top-line first-valid-row inline, '+ N more outcomes' disclosure over the surveyBuildOutcomes list, bindSurveyMore toggle, stale-island degrade ships the list visible), studyBuildSection gains the cx-study--compact modifier (same DOM), bottleBuildNode the slim-band branch (points stay in the untouched modal); the ba* builders + PROOF_ORDER ba row + dispatch branch are deleted (the verified_before_after EVIDENCE marker moves to cellexia-proof.js); boot()'s verified branch sets window.CellexiaBooster.__preview = true for the proof asset's beacon/draft contract. Pinned by sims/survey-methodology.cjs (C-series + mutants m11/m12) + harness v8 block.

v8 NEW shared asset: ES5 IIFE with pf-prefixed helper twins (zero name overlap with the pdp sim extraction surface), proofFetch (8s timeout, one retry, cb(null) fail-closed), the press band / endorsement wall / results gallery renderers + filter drawer + lightbox, ZERO innerHTML anywhere (SVG via createElementNS, entity decode via a bounded replace chain), every URL through the pfHttps gate, beacons suppressed via window.CellexiaBooster.__preview OR sessionStorage cx_preview_token. Carries the moved verified_before_after EVIDENCE marker plus the press/derm_endorsements markers. Pinned by harness (EVIDENCE, class coverage, zero-innerHTML escape discipline) + sims/proof-gallery.cjs (29-function extraction, 6 mutants).

v8.2 ultra-compact branches (cm-guarded, textContent-only, same DOM): pressBuildSection collapses to one row (quote starts [hidden]; bindLogo tap reveals + rotates, a second tap on the ACTIVE logo re-hides + clears aria-pressed); endoBuildSection composes ONE

head row (count · shown_of, per-part degrade, re-composed by setProgress after Show more appends into the same wall); resultsBuildSection emits only the cx-results--compact root modifier (CSS leverage). cm-absent paths byte-identical to v8. Pinned by sims/proof-gallery.cjs U/V series + mutants m7/m8/m9 and the harness class-coverage self-test (--compact trio).

v8.3 COMPACT middle tier: each of the three builders resolves density ONCE (var ultra = conf.cm === 2; var compact = conf.cm === 1; strict === so strings/unknown codes fall back to full) and the v8.2 branches are repointed to cm 2 under RENAMED --ultra root modifiers (cx-press--ultra / cx-endo--ultra / cx-results--ultra); cm 1 now means the NEW compact tier (cx-press--compact: quote ALWAYS visible, rotation like full; cx-endo--compact: composed H2 head line with inline shown_of; cx-results--compact: root-modifier-only CSS leverage). Pinned by sims/proof-gallery.cjs U/C series + mutants m7/m8/m10 and the harness class-coverage self-test (--compact + --ultra trios).

v8.7 NEW embed replacing the three v8 SECTION blocks (press/derm-endorsements/results-gallery .liquid, entries retired this wave): the store's legacy Liquid templates cannot take section app blocks (merchant-verified), so the three proof widgets merge into ONE app embed (target body, name 'Cellexia proof library', 22 chars). The #cx-press-config/#cx-endo-config/#cx-results-config islands keep their v8/v8.3 payload byte-for-byte (incl. the two-code cm density members) — only the gate assigns are renamed per widget (cx_p_*/cx_e_*/cx_r_*) and the data-cx-mount divs are gone: cellexia-proof.js now self-inserts via the ordered .cx-proof-band (after .pdp__tabs on product pages, end of #main elsewhere, fail-closed). Pinned by harness section-5 v8.7 block + the CM_ISLANDS density pins.

v8.13 product display names: new `assign cx_pname = product.metafields.cellexia.display_name.value | default: product.title` and the three name interpolations (survey rec_line, survey outcomes_intro, study sub) switch from product.title to cx_pname. The metafield is translatable (native Shopify translations registered by the Product names admin page), so localized pages serve the merchant's exact per-language name; unset falls back to the title — byte-identical output for shops that never set a display name.

v8.13b {name} placeholder in custom text (merchant catch: 'Tested on {name} itself' rendered the literal braces): the 14 merchant-entered text substitution sites of the survey island (title/question/intro/outcome statements/methodology, plus verifier via a single assign-site replace covering both its emissions) and study island (title/concern/subject/footnote/result labels/result suffixes/lab name/instruments) gain `| replace: '{name}', cx_pname` before | json, so custom copy can interpolate the per-language display name exactly like the built-in lines. No-op for text without the token.

v10 US delivery by state: new cx_us assign gated on cx_country == 'US' and cx_de.usStates.enabled == true; the delivery member gains the conditional nested us member ({% if cx_us %}, "us": {{ cx_us | json }}{% endif %} — nested, so no new top-level cfg key) and deliveryStrings gains "delivery.deliver_to" (label only, NOT a required key — a missing string hides only the selector). Pinned by harness section-5 v10 pins + sims/us-state-delivery.mjs.

v10 US delivery by state: new cx_us assign gated on cx_country == 'US' and cx_de.usStates.enabled == true; the delivery member gains the conditional nested us member ({% if cx_us %}, "us": {{ cx_us | json }}{% endif %}) and deliveryStrings gains "delivery.deliver_to" — the exact twin of the pdp-booster emission. Pinned by harness section-5 v10 pins + sims/us-state-delivery.mjs.

v10 US delivery by state: the az standalone delivery member gains the same cx_us gate + conditional nested us member ({% if cx_us %}, "us": {{ cx_us | json }}{% endif %}) and its deliveryStrings map gains "delivery.deliver_to", so az-only pages keep the state promise (azGapFillConfig copies cfg.delivery wholesale — the nested us rides along). Pinned by harness section-5 v10 pins + sims/us-state-delivery.mjs.

v10 US state overlay: deliveryConfig gains the fail-OPEN state layer (per-field keep-if-valid candidate merge, whole-entry discard on an incoherent window, hidden:true -> null, cutoff -> cutoffMinutes + dispatchDays partial dispatch override, dc.extra/dc.usFederal/dc.us) and deliveryQualifies the dc.extra + dc.usFederal clauses; new byte-twinned US_STATE_NAMES + deliveryUs* region (deliveryUsFederal movable-holiday math, choice/geo persistence via localStorage 'cx:us_state' + sessionStorage 'cx_geo:1' 6h TTL, single-flight geo kick to 'apps/cellexia/geo', 'Deliver to' selector built createElement/textContent-only); dispatchSchedule substitutes the RESOLVED state cutoff/dispatchDays; CX_AZ_ICONS gains 'pin'; mountDelivery/azMountDeliveryLine attach the selector + geo kick. v10 fix wave adds byte-twinned deliveryUsPrime (synchronous pre-mount state resolution, called at init() top before any mount/beacon), deliveryUsBroadcast + deliveryUsEventToken (the 'cx:us-state' cross-bundle fan-out) and deliveryUsPointerCoarse (coarse-close / fine-stay-open selector change semantics), plus the hidden-state option filter and the stored-hidden-choice auto-clear. Pinned by sims/us-state-delivery.mjs (twins, 4-way federal parity, overlay matrix, geo + prime units, dispatchSchedule coherence, selector DOM incl. pointer split + fan-out, mutants M1-M8), sims/delivery-businessdays.mjs FUNCS extraction and harness v10 pins.

v10 US state overlay, byte-twin of the cellexia-pdp.js change: deliveryConfig state layer + deliveryQualifies dc.extra/dc.usFederal clauses, the US_STATE_NAMES + deliveryUs* twin region ('cx:us_state'/'cx_geo:1'/'apps/cellexia/geo' literals, selector, geo kick), dispatchSchedule resolved-state cutoff/dispatchDays substitution, CX_AZ_ICONS 'pin' entry; renderDelivery attaches the selector and kicks the geo hint. v10 fix wave adds the byte-twinned deliveryUsPrime (called at renderInto() top before the render decisions), deliveryUsBroadcast + deliveryUsEventToken 'cx:us-state' fan-out and deliveryUsPointerCoarse close split, plus the hidden-state option filter + stored-hidden-choice auto-clear. First allowlist entry for this file (baseline-clean before v10). Pinned by sims/us-state-delivery.mjs per-symbol twin byte-identity + behavioral matrix on BOTH bundles (incl. the pdp+cart shared-document fan-out pairing), sims/delivery-businessdays.mjs and harness v10 pins.

v8.22 wall/overlay design codes: the cx-endo-config island gains two lean members — "ws":1 when cfg.dermEndorsements.wallStyle == "panel" (official fixed-height panel wall) and "os":1 when cfg.dermEndorsements.overlayStyle == "official" (explainer overlay: intro + FAQ dropdowns + dermatologist roster). Absent members = the classic wall / list overlay, so a stale island keeps the v8.21 behavior. The overlay-content COPY (intro/FAQ/roster title/panel CTA) deliberately does NOT ride the island: it has non-blank English defaults and no locale-catalog fallback, so the proxy serves it translated-else-source in payload.copy (zero Liquid bytes). Pinned by sims/proof-gallery.cjs P/OF series + harness v8.22 block.

v12 per-market product exclusions: new cx_pgid assign ('gid://shopify/Product/' | append: product.id) + cx_exc_dsp flag off cfg.dispatch.excludedByMarket[cx_market] contains cx_pgid; the live dispatch gate gains `and cx_exc_dsp == false`, the draft gate becomes `unless cfg.dispatch.showOnPdp == false or cx_exc_dsp`; the delivery exclusion (cfg.deliveryEstimate.excludedByMarket) FOLDS into cx_del_hidden so live + draft delivery paths are both bound (the byCountry-hidden precedent). No island-member changes — an excluded product simply gets no dispatch/delivery emission, so beacons stay honest for free. Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block.

v12 per-market product exclusions: new az_pgid assign + two flags — the delivery/dispatch exclusion folds into az_del_hidden (az_delivery_line hides on EITHER list: the line bundles the delivery date AND the order-within countdown clause, so either promise being untrue for the product invalidates it — killing az_any_delivery also drops thresholdOk, which azTplPayload keys on), and az_exc_sf off cfg.amazon.shipsFromExcludedByMarket gates the live + draft az_ships_from paths AND the shipsFrom member emission ({%- if az_any_micro and az_exc_sf == false %}) — the member is the micro ships row's ONLY warehouse/defaultLabel source, and dropping `ships` alone would have flipped the micro fallback ON (the v6.8.1 yield rule inverts). Both JS read sites are null-guarded, so the absent member renders nothing. Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block.

v12 per-market product exclusions: two assigns read the CURRENT market's lists (cx_exc_d = cfg.dispatch.excludedByMarket[cx_market], cx_exc_e = cfg.deliveryEstimate.excludedByMarket[cx_market]) and a new gated island member emits them ({%- if cx_exc_d or cx_exc_e %} "exc": {"d": .. | json, "e": .. | json},) between the dc and delivery members — the cart is client-mutable, so the verdict must be computed in JS at render time from state.cart, not baked at Liquid render. Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block; the deploy-safety island matrix parses the new branch.

v12 per-market product exclusions: new CART-ONLY helper cartExcludedAny(list) (state.cart items vs 'gid://shopify/Product/' + product_id; deliberately NOT a pdp twin — the dispatchSchedule per-file rule) plus one early-return gate in renderDispatch (after the cfg.dc check, before the PREVIEW branch) and one in renderDelivery (after featureOn, before deliveryConfig): `if (cartExcludedAny(cfg.exc && cfg.exc.d|e)) return null;`. A null return means no node AND no impression (renderAll only tracks returned feature keys), and renderInto re-runs on every cart rebuild so client-side cart changes re-verdict without a reload. Exclusion applies in preview too (the byCountry-hidden precedent). Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block.

v12 review fix (preview honesty): new DISPATCH_PREVIEW_EXCLUDED constant + a cfg.dspx === 1 branch in mountDispatchPreview's invalid-config path — an exclusion-hidden product in a verified preview session names the exclusion (plain cx-preview-note) instead of rendering the false DISPATCH_PREVIEW_INVALID schedule warning (the island suppresses the dispatch member for excluded products, which mountDispatchPreview otherwise reads as an invalid schedule). The dspx marker is emitted by pdp-booster.liquid ONLY while a preview is armed, so real visitors' payloads are byte-identical. Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block (marker emission + JS branch).

v14 rewards (SPEC-v14 §4): `cx_rw = cfg.rewards` alias; the armed block gains cx_draft_rw (draftFlags.set_savings/gift_tiers OR either master) joined into cx_cart_draft_any; the master gate admits either rewards master; the liquid block computes cx_eff_ss / cx_eff_gt (master AND marketScopes.set_savings / gift_tiers allow cx_market) and the effective map always emits "setSavings"/"giftTiers"; a gated "rw" member ({%- if cx_eff_ss or cx_eff_gt or cx_draft_rw %}) ships {"ss": rewards.setSavings | json, "gt": rewards.giftTiers | json, "paused": gift_stock.value.paused[cx_market], "gifts": {"<vid>": {h,t,c,a}}} built from a {% liquid %} capture over tiers/slots/options + samplePool → all_products lookup; 16 rw.* strings (one-letter @@A@@/@@P@@/@@N@@/@@C@@/@@G@@/@@V@@ sentinels) inside the same gate; the products map flags sample-sachet products with "s": 1 (twin of proxy.cart-data PRODUCT_BODY_LIQUID). 21,198 → 23,439 B (cap 23,600). Pinned by harness v14 block (gate/member/effective/scope anchors + per-file cap) + sims/rewards-tiers.mjs; the deploy-safety island-JSON matrix parses the new branch.

v14 rewards (SPEC-v14 §5): `cx_rw = cfg.rewards.setSavings` alias; az_eff_ss (master AND marketScopes.set_savings allows cx_market, the az_eff_* pattern), cx_draft_ss inside the armed block, az_any_ss joins az_any AND az_need_product; island member gated on az_any_ss: "rw": {live, tiers | json (settings shape {count,pct,code}), sf {pdp,sim,fbt}, excl (setSavingsExcludedByMarket[cx_market] raw), giftPids [<all_products[handle].id …>, 0]}; strings rw.pdp_line/pdp_line_next/fbt_caption/fbt_add_save/similar_caption via a for-loop over a split list; "effective" gains "set_savings". Byte diet to stay under the cap (behaviour-neutral): the seven header assign/if lines folded into the {%- liquid block, the nine `assign cx_draft_az_* = false` inits removed (nil is falsy; only ever read in if conditions), amazon.fbt_add_1..4 emitted by a (1..4) for-loop. 18,756 → 19,673 B (cap 19,700). Pinned by harness v14 block (member/effective/scope anchors + per-file cap).

v14 rewards (SPEC-v14 §6/§7): CART_FEATURE_KEYS += setSavings/giftTiers; state.rw per-render snapshot; NEW "v14 rewards" region before renderInto(): the cxRwTier/cxRwNext twin (byte-identical to cellexia-pdp.js, pinned by sims/rewards-tiers.mjs), RW/RW_DEFAULTS (21 keys)/RW_SENTINELS/rwT, CART-ONLY helpers rwSpendCents/rwEligibleLines/rwDistinctCount/rwUnits/rwGiftLines/rwDesiredCode/rwSyncCode/rwSyncGifts/rwRenderMeter/rwRenderNudge/rwDecorateGiftRows (+ rwGiftPlan/rwPickSamples/rwKitActive/rwKitSavingCents/rwPerformGiftRemove/Swap/rwGiftBack/rwSnapshot/rwSimRead/Write/rwPreviewControls, session memories cx_rw_gift_removed/unfree/choice); renderInto: rwSnapshot() then the gift METER (rwRenderMeter when giftTiers on, renderShipbar fallback) then the NUDGE; renderAll: rwDecorateGiftRows() then rwSyncCode() → rwSyncGifts(); shipbar/az-free-line/distinct-count/offers/cross-sell read rwSpendCents() and skip gift/sachet lines; cross-sell reframe (rw.set_title, struck price × (1 − pct)); preview bar simulator (rwPreviewControls); boot PREVIEW gains sim/rehearsal/rw. Track: set_savings code_applied, gift_tiers tier_reached/gift_added/gift_removed. Markers 'data-cx-feature','gift_tiers' (meter) / 'set_savings' (nudge). ES5, no new innerHTML. Pinned by harness v14 block + EVIDENCE + sims/rewards-tiers.mjs cart-only rule.

v14 rewards (SPEC-v14 §5/§6/§7): NEW region before the az entry — the cxRwTier/cxRwNext twin (byte-identical to cellexia-cart.js, pinned by sims/rewards-tiers.mjs), RW_DEFAULTS (5 PDP keys), PDP-only azRw* helpers (azRwT/azRwCfg/azRwTiers/azRwPct/azRwOn/azRwNum/azRwIdSet/azRwSkip/azRwCartCount/azRwSub/azRwFbtApply), azBuildRwPdp (p.cx-az-row.cx-rw-pdp[data-cx-feature=set_savings]) + azMountRwPdp (after .stock-msg, skipped for excluded/gift/sachet products, tracks set_savings once); hooks: azFbtUpdate (tier for the checked count → discounted total + struck original + fbt_add_save label), azFbtFinish (fbt_caption), azFbtCollect/azMountSimilar pick loops + azFbtEnrich/similar byHandle stage skip gift/sachet/excluded via azRwSkip, similar caption, AZ_BUYBOX_ORDER gains '.cx-rw-pdp', azInit calls azMountRwPdp(). Cart awareness reads window.CartJS.cart.items only (never a fetch). ES5, no new innerHTML (10 pinned sites unchanged). Pinned by harness v14 block + EVIDENCE + sims/fbt.cjs (extraction carries the azRw* helpers) + sims/rewards-tiers.mjs pdp-only rule.
